esqueleto:
fn solve(k: Int, a: Int, b: Int, v: Int) -> Int
  requires (2 <= k)
  requires (k <= 1000)
  requires (1 <= a)
  requires (a <= 1000)
  requires (1 <= b)
  requires (b <= 1000)
  requires (1 <= v)
  requires (v <= 1000)
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures (result <= 1009)
  ensures (a <= (v * (result + (if (b <= ((k - 1) * result)) then b else ((k - 1) * result)))))
  ensures ((result == 1) or (not (a <= (v * ((result - 1) + (if (b <= ((k - 1) * (result - 1))) then b else ((k - 1) * (result - 1))))))))
  ensures exists i in 1..(1009 + 1): (((a <= (v * (i + (if (b <= ((k - 1) * i)) then b else ((k - 1) * i))))) and (result == i)) and (forall j in 1..i: not (a <= (v * (j + (if (b <= ((k - 1) * j)) then b else ((k - 1) * j)))))))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, 0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
